name: Hardware Keys to Home Assistant
description: Forwards the hardware buttons of the device, such as the F1 to F4 keys of a Shelly Wall Display XL, to Home Assistant as events. Build automations on the kiosk_satellite_key event, even when the vendor app does not receive the keys.
author: mfgdev

settings.title: Keys to forward
settings.description: Comma-separated Android key names without the KEYCODE_ prefix, for example F1,F2,F3,F4 or VOLUME_UP. Leave empty to forward every key.

settings.title: Home Assistant event type
settings.description: Name of the event fired on the Home Assistant event bus for each press.

settings.title: Source name
settings.description: Sent as event_data.source. Use it to tell several kiosks apart, for example hallway-wall.
